version.description: Version of this file's format (1). Optional: a file without it is version 1.

video.description: Video name (usually the scenario file name).

text.description: Video title shown by the intro card.

component.description: Intro component "namespace/name" (default: the theme's), e.g. studio/intro-stack.

params.description: Component params (see the component's params schema; unset params take its defaults).

duration.description: Seconds (default: template intro.duration; a video or Lottie file: its own length).

video.description: A video file of the project (.mp4, .mov, .webm, .m4v — H.264, HEVC, VP8, VP9, AV1 or ProRes) shown instead of a component; its own sound is kept.

image.description: An image file of the project (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .svg) shown instead of a component.

lottie.description: A Lottie animation of the project (bodymovin .json) played by studio/lottie instead of a component.

from.description: Video: the second of the file the part shown starts at (default 0).

to.description: Video: the second of the file the part shown ends at (default: the file's end).

fit.description: cover (fills, cropped) or contain (whole). Default: an overlay contains; a segment covers when the file has about the frame's shape, else contains.

background.description: Around a contained or transparent file: theme (the theme background, default), a theme colour key (paper, dark, accent…), a CSS colour or none.

volume.description: Video: volume of the file's own sound, 0–1 (default 1).

intro.description: Intro card overrides {component, params, duration}, or your own file {video | image | lottie, …}; `false` disables the intro card.

component.description: Outro component "namespace/name" (default: the theme's), e.g. studio/outro-stack.

params.description: Component params (see the component's params schema; unset params take its defaults).

tagline.description: Tagline under the logo (default: template outro.tagline).

url.description: URL shown by the outro (default: template outro.url, else brand.url).

duration.description: Seconds (default: template outro.duration; a video or Lottie file: its own length).

video.description: A video file of the project (.mp4, .mov, .webm, .m4v — H.264, HEVC, VP8, VP9, AV1 or ProRes) shown instead of a component; its own sound is kept.

image.description: An image file of the project (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .svg) shown instead of a component.

lottie.description: A Lottie animation of the project (bodymovin .json) played by studio/lottie instead of a component.

from.description: Video: the second of the file the part shown starts at (default 0).

to.description: Video: the second of the file the part shown ends at (default: the file's end).

fit.description: cover (fills, cropped) or contain (whole). Default: an overlay contains; a segment covers when the file has about the frame's shape, else contains.

background.description: Around a contained or transparent file: theme (the theme background, default), a theme colour key (paper, dark, accent…), a CSS colour or none.

volume.description: Video: volume of the file's own sound, 0–1 (default 1).

outro.description: Outro card overrides {component, params, tagline, url, duration}, or your own file {video | image | lottie, …}; `false` disables the outro card.

env.description: Environment name (default: project default_env, else the first one).

vars.description: Free variables usable as {{vars.x}} (and {{x}} when not shadowed).

setup.description: Hooks run before capture (rolled back automatically).

teardown.description: Hooks run after capture, even after a failure.

hooks.description: Named hooks a `hook: <name>` step runs during the take (a name here wins over project.yaml's).

frame.description: Frame of every scene (default: the project frame): raw, card, browser, laptop, phone, tablet or a layout component id "namespace/name".

defaults.description: Step defaults (win over the project's), e.g. {timeout_s: 30} for a product whose actions take long.

file.description: Audio file relative to the project dir.

loop.description: Loop a track shorter than the video (default true, crossfaded seams); false: play it once.

tutorial.description: Automatic tutorial overlays fed by the timeline: true, false or {shortcuts, spotlight, steps, loupe, progress}.

min_s.description: Shortest length the video aims at, seconds.

max_s.description: Longest length the video aims at, seconds.

target_length.description: The length this video aims at (L5.5): the review's video-length rule uses it instead of the reference 60–120 s.

caption_component.description: Caption component of the whole video (default: the theme's), e.g. studio/caption-overlay; a render's overrides.components.caption wins over it.

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-11-02T10:24:00 (without an offset: wall time in the browser's time zone).

freeze.description: true: the clock never moves (timers still run; code measuring time with Date stalls). Default false: it starts at `at` when the capture starts and runs.

anyOf.description: The date and time the product's browser clock reads when the capture starts, so every take shows the same dates and times.

clock.description: The product's clock when the capture starts (wins over the project's): an ISO date-time or {at, freeze}; false turns the project's clock off.

request.description: "[METHOD ]<page>:/path" or "[METHOD ]/path", e.g. "POST shop:/api/quotes"; * matches within a path segment, ** anything; the query is ignored.

body.description: Raw body of the answer (text/plain unless content_type).

items.description: Answer to a write stopped on a read-only run, so the flow continues on screen.

mocks.description: Answers to writes stopped on read-only runs (tried before the environment's read_only.mocks); ignored on read-write runs.

scenes.description: Scenes, cards and interstitials, in order.

title: Retake scenario
description: A product video: hooks, scenes and steps.

rollback.description: Request that undoes this one (templated after the request: {{response.json.id}}).

name.description: Name shown in logs and journals.

destructive.description: Declare the hook destructive explicitly (also auto-detected).

optional.description: Continue even if this hook fails.

writes.description: Shell hooks only: false declares that the command only reads, so it may run on a read-only environment.

anyOf.title: http
anyOf.description: HTTP request (fetch); response saved for templating; optional rollback request.
A .sql file relative to the project dir (a sandbox seed: to sandbox.yaml), or an inline query.

file.description: SQL file relative to the project dir (a sandbox seed: to sandbox.yaml).

db.description: Database key from project.databases (default: the first one).

rollback.description: SQL that undoes this hook: a *.sql file or inline SQL.

name.description: Name shown in logs and journals.

destructive.description: Declare the hook destructive explicitly (also auto-detected).

optional.description: Continue even if this hook fails.

writes.description: Shell hooks only: false declares that the command only reads, so it may run on a read-only environment.

anyOf.title: sql
anyOf.description: SQL file or inline query run in a transaction (project.databases).
Command run with sh -c in the project dir (a sandbox seed: the folder of sandbox.yaml); every host it names must be allowed.

name.description: Name shown in logs and journals.

destructive.description: Declare the hook destructive explicitly (also auto-detected).

optional.description: Continue even if this hook fails.

writes.description: Shell hooks only: false declares that the command only reads, so it may run on a read-only environment.

anyOf.title: shell
anyOf.description: Shell command (sh -c) in the project dir; every host it names must be allowed.
Inline JS (function body) evaluated in the js hook tab of the first environment page.

code.description: Inline JS (function body; may return / await).

file.description: JS file relative to the project dir.

page.description: Environment page key whose hook tab runs it (default: the first page).

name.description: Name shown in logs and journals.

destructive.description: Declare the hook destructive explicitly (also auto-detected).

optional.description: Continue even if this hook fails.

writes.description: Shell hooks only: false declares that the command only reads, so it may run on a read-only environment.

anyOf.title: js
anyOf.description: JavaScript evaluated in its own tab on an environment page (through the runner); requests to unlisted hosts are blocked.

HookStep.description: Exactly one of http, sql, shell, js, plus name / confirm / destructive / optional / writes.

scale.description: deviceScaleFactor: 1, or 2 for 4K from a 1920×1080 viewport.

quality.description: JPEG quality of the screencast frames (1-100, default 90).

keep_frames.description: Keep the screencast frames in runs/<id>/frames (real timing, for the raw export). Default false: capture.mp4 is encoded during the take.

crf.description: libx264 CRF of capture.mp4 (when the encoder is libx264).

encoder.description: Encoder of capture.mp4, fed during the take: auto (default: the Mac's hardware H.264 encoder when ffmpeg has it, else libx264), videotoolbox or libx264.

prewarm.description: Visit each page of the scenario once off camera before the take, so the first visit is not filmed cold. Default false.

step_shots.description: Keep one picture per step of a capture in runs/<id>/screenshots (the captured frame at the end of each step), as a dry run does. Default false.

CaptureOverrides.description: Capture settings (merged over the defaults: 1920×1080, scale 1, 30 fps, jpeg 90, frames not kept, encoder auto, crf 16).

anyOf.description: How the capture is framed: raw, card, browser chrome, laptop, phone or tablet mockup.
Layout of a multi-page scene: split (side by side, stacked in vertical) or pip (picture in picture).
A layout component id "namespace/name", e.g. studio/layout-card or a workspace layout.

Frame.description: How the capture is framed: raw, card, browser, laptop, phone or tablet (built-in layouts studio/layout-<style>), split or pip for a multi-page scene (studio/layout-split, studio/layout-pip), or a layout component id "namespace/name".

move_base_ms.description: Cursor travel: ms = clamp(move_base_ms + distance·move_ms_per_px, move_min_ms, move_max_ms).

move_ms_per_px.description: See move_base_ms (field notes: 0.9 ms per px).

nudge_px.description: Moves shorter than this (px) are nudges: repeated clicks on almost the same spot.

nudge_ms.description: Travel time of a nudge of nudge_px (shorter nudges: down to 60 % of it; zero-length moves: 0).

nudge_hover_ms.description: Hover pause before pressing after a nudge.

after_popup_ms.description: Pause after a click that opened a popup (600–1000).

after_navigation_ms.description: Minimum time after a click that navigated or changed the URL before the next step (1.5–2.8 s).

popup_fallback_ms.description: How long a click gets to show that an expected popup opened (aria-expanded / new popup, polled) before the next click strategy.

popup_timeout_ms.description: How long the last click strategy waits for an expected popup before reporting it missing.

type_cps.description: Typing speed, characters per second (~14); a type step without cps adapts it: search fields ≤ 10, long free text up to 24.

page_switch_ms.description: Multi-page scenes: pause before a step that acts on another page than the previous step (its cursor then glides from where it rests).

scroll_offset.description: Default scroll offset with a target (−140 ⇒ the target ends 140 px below the top).

jitter.description: Deterministic ±fraction jitter applied to durations (0 = none).

settle_ms.description: After navigation: wait for network idle up to this many ms.

park_hold.description: Seconds a step's `park: true` holds the cursor still on the result (1.5–2.6).

park_scroll_hold.description: Seconds a scroll's `park: true` holds the cursor next to the target (3–3.5).

PacingOverrides.description: Deterministic pacing overrides (merged over the field-tested defaults).

timeout_s.description: Seconds every wait and action waits when it has no `timeout` of its own: targets, wait_for, wait_for_email, download… (built-in: 15; 30 for wait_for_email and download).

RunDefaults.description: Defaults of every step (a scenario's win over the project's).

component.description: Overlay component drawing it (default: the built-in one), "namespace/name".

params.description: Component params (see the component's params schema; unset params take its defaults).

shortcuts.description: Key caps of `press` steps, timed on the real key press (studio/overlay-shortcut).

on.description: steps: every step with a target, over the whole step; clicks: around each click.

component.description: Overlay component drawing it (default: the built-in one), "namespace/name".

params.description: Component params (see the component's params schema; unset params take its defaults).

spotlight.description: Dim the screen except the step's target (studio/overlay-spotlight): steps (= true), clicks, false or {on, component, params}.

component.description: Overlay component drawing it (default: the built-in one), "namespace/name".

params.description: Component params (see the component's params schema; unset params take its defaults).

steps.description: Numbered badges (1, 2, 3…) next to clicked targets (studio/overlay-steps).

component.description: Overlay component drawing it (default: the built-in one), "namespace/name".

params.description: Component params (see the component's params schema; unset params take its defaults).

loupe.description: A magnified view of the field during `type` steps (studio/overlay-loupe).

chapters.description: scenes: every scene and card is a chapter; cards: each card opens a chapter.

component.description: Overlay component drawing it (default: the built-in one), "namespace/name".

params.description: Component params (see the component's params schema; unset params take its defaults).

progress.description: Chapter progress bar across the video (studio/overlay-progress), scenario level only: scenes (= true), cards, false or {chapters, component, params}.

TutorialSpec.description: Automatic tutorial overlays fed by the timeline; the most specific level (step → scene → scenario) wins.

Tutorial.description: Tutorial overlays: true (all on), false (all off) or the switches {shortcuts, spotlight, steps, loupe, progress}.

SceneEntry.description: A captured scene, an interstitial or a card.

id.description: Unique, slug-like scene id.

caption.description: Caption for the whole scene (a step caption replaces it).

page.description: Environment page key (e.g. console, shop). Default: the previous scene's page, else the first key.

open.description: Path or URL opened at scene start. Omit to continue from the previous scene's state.

persona.description: The persona this scene's page is signed in as (project auth.personas), or none. Default: the persona whose `pages` list the environment page; a page keeps one persona for the whole run.

speed.description: Edit-time speed for the whole scene, in (0, 8].

still.description: Seconds of stillness at scene start (default pacing.scene_start_still).

transition.description: Transition INTO this scene: crossfade, cut, fade-black or a transition component (default: the theme's).

frame.description: Frame of this scene (default: the scenario frame, else the project frame): raw, card, browser, laptop, phone, tablet, split / pip (multi-page scenes) or a layout component id "namespace/name".

tutorial.description: Tutorial overlays of this scene's steps, over the scenario's (progress is scenario-only).

irreversible.description: Every step is irreversible (dry-run stops the scene at its first step).

offscreen.description: Played during the take but left out of the video (a scene that prepares what the next ones film).

Scene.title: scene
Scene.description: A captured scene: optional page + open, then steps.

page.description: Environment page key whose base URL a relative `open` resolves against (default: the page id when it is one, else the key before ":" in `open`).

open.description: Opened at the scene start: a path, "<environment page>:<path>" (e.g. shop:/products) or a URL. Omit to continue the page as it is.

label.description: Name a layout may show next to the page ("Buyer").

persona.description: The persona this page is signed in as (project auth.personas), or none. Default: the persona whose `pages` list its environment page.

ScenePages.description: Pages filmed at the same time (instead of `page` / `open`): a map page id → {page?, open?, viewport?, label?, cursor?, persona?}, or a list of environment page keys / {id?, page, open?, viewport?…} (default id: the page key, plus "-<preset>" for another viewport than desktop).

page.description: Environment page key whose base URL a relative `open` resolves against (default: the page id when it is one, else the key before ":" in `open`).

open.description: Opened at the scene start: a path, "<environment page>:<path>" (e.g. shop:/products) or a URL. Omit to continue the page as it is.

label.description: Name a layout may show next to the page ("Buyer").

persona.description: The persona this page is signed in as (project auth.personas), or none. Default: the persona whose `pages` list its environment page.

ScenePage.description: One page of a multi-page scene.

mobile.description: Emulate a mobile device (meta viewport, overlay scrollbars).

Viewport.description: A page viewport: desktop (the capture size), laptop (1440×900), tablet (820×1180), mobile (390×844) or {width, height, mobile?, touch?}.

SceneCursor.description: Where the cursor rests at the scene start: 'auto' (default: a neutral point near the first pointer target, never on it), 'keep' (where the previous scene left it), a viewport point {x, y}, or a target to rest on. Use {text: auto} for an element whose text is "auto".

Point.description: Absolute viewport point in CSS px.

TargetSpec.description: Visible text ("Save"), a CSS selector string ("#id", ".class", "[attr]", "a > b") or a target object.

text.description: Visible text, whitespace-normalised. Exact match first, then case-insensitive substring (unless `exact`).

contains.description: Element whose text contains ALL these strings; the innermost such element wins.

role.description: ARIA role (explicit or implicit): button, link, textbox, combobox, checkbox, option, menuitem, row, dialog, tab…

label.description: Form control whose label text matches.

in.description: Restrict the search to a scope: dialog, menu, listbox, popover, page, {row: "text"} or a target.

nth.description: 0-based index among visible matches (negative = from the end).

last_visible.description: Pick the LAST visible match (e.g. the most recently mounted popover).

exact.description: Disable the substring fallback of text/name/aria/label.

TargetObject.description: Element locator. Combine keys to narrow the match (e.g. {text: Save, in: dialog}).

ScopeSpec.description: Scope keyword (topmost visible dialog/menu/listbox/popover, or the whole page), {row: "text"} or a target object.

url.description: Path (resolved against the page base URL) or absolute URL.

page.description: Environment page key to open in (default: current page).

open.description: Navigate the current page (or `page`) to a path or URL.

id.description: Step id, used in refs ("scene.step") and by --until.

caption.description: Caption shown from this step's start until the next caption or scene end.

speed.description: Edit-time playback speed for this step's span (overrides the scene speed).

hold.description: Seconds of stillness AFTER the step; never trimmed by the editor.

tutorial.description: Tutorial overlays of this step, over the scene's and the scenario's, e.g. {spotlight: false}; false = none on this step.

on.description: Multi-page scenes: the page this step acts on, a key of the scene's `pages` (default: its first page).

mark.description: Named marker (editor: speed 1 around it; review: key frame).

timeout.description: Seconds before the step fails (default: the scenario's or project's defaults.timeout_s, else 15).

optional.description: A failure is logged (run.json optional_failures) but does not abort the run.

retry_click.description: click / double_click: a click that produced nothing within about a second (no request, DOM change, navigation, dialog) is made once more; a second dead click fails the step.

irreversible.description: Not executed in dry-run: the runner hovers the target, screenshots and stops the scene.

park.description: Park the cursor after the step: next to a scroll target (clear of its text), else away from what changed since the last action; true holds pacing.park_scroll_hold / park_hold (or `hold`), a number holds that many seconds.

Step.description: Exactly one action (open, click, double_click, hover, type, press, select, pick, menu, date, scroll, drag, drop_file, wait, wait_for, hold, assert, screenshot, new_tab, switch_page, eval, notify, emit, cursor, wait_for_email, download, capture_text, hook) plus optional modifiers (id, caption, speed, hold, camera, overlay, tutorial, on, mark, timeout, optional, retry_click, irreversible, park, note).

zoom.description: Zoom factor (1 = none). Clamped to the template max_zoom.

target.description: What to centre on. Default: the step target, else the cursor.

duration.description: Duration of the zoom move in seconds (≥ 0.8).

until.description: How long the zoom stays: step_end, scene_end (default) or N seconds.

CameraHint.description: Edit-time camera move keyed to this step. The camera is static otherwise.

Ease.description: Easing preset or cubic-bezier [x1, y1, x2, y2].

component.description: Overlay component "namespace/name", e.g. studio/overlay-callout or studio/overlay-lower-third (or a video, image or lottie file instead).

slots.description: Slot values (title, kicker, text…) as the component declares them.

params.description: Component params (see the component's params schema; unset params take its defaults).

duration.description: Seconds on screen, at most 30 (default: the component's duration; a file: its own length).

target.description: Element the overlay points at, measured at the end of the step after any scroll (default: the step target, else the cursor).

video.description: A video file of the project (.mp4, .mov, .webm, .m4v — H.264, HEVC, VP8, VP9, AV1 or ProRes) shown instead of a component; its own sound is kept.

image.description: An image file of the project (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .svg) shown instead of a component.

lottie.description: A Lottie animation of the project (bodymovin .json) played by studio/lottie instead of a component.

from.description: Video: the second of the file the part shown starts at (default 0).

to.description: Video: the second of the file the part shown ends at (default: the file's end).

fit.description: cover (fills, cropped) or contain (whole). Default: an overlay contains; a segment covers when the file has about the frame's shape, else contains.

volume.description: Video: volume of the file's own sound, 0–1 (default 1).

at.description: When it starts: end / step (the end of the step, default), start, click, mark:<name> or seconds after the step starts.

anchor.description: Where a file (video with alpha, image, Lottie) goes: target (default when the step has one), cursor, screen (the whole visible capture), center or a side / corner of the screen.

rect.description: Where a file goes, as a rect of the page in CSS px (instead of anchor).

scale.description: Size of a file relative to its own size in page CSS px (default 1).

loop.description: Replay a video or Lottie file for the whole duration (default false: it plays once and holds its last frame).

Overlay.description: Edit-time overlay (callout, lower third, badge…) shown over the clip from the end of this step; the runner records the target bbox. Or your own file composited over the capture: {video | image | lottie, at, anchor | rect, scale, duration, loop}.

text.description: Visible text, whitespace-normalised. Exact match first, then case-insensitive substring (unless `exact`).

contains.description: Element whose text contains ALL these strings; the innermost such element wins.

role.description: ARIA role (explicit or implicit): button, link, textbox, combobox, checkbox, option, menuitem, row, dialog, tab…

label.description: Form control whose label text matches.

in.description: Restrict the search to a scope: dialog, menu, listbox, popover, page, {row: "text"} or a target.

nth.description: 0-based index among visible matches (negative = from the end).

last_visible.description: Pick the LAST visible match (e.g. the most recently mounted popover).

exact.description: Disable the substring fallback of text/name/aria/label.

strategy.description: auto = real input, then DOM click, then pointer-event sequence when an expected popup did not open.

expect_popup.description: Force popup detection on/off (default: inferred from aria attributes).

outside.description: Click somewhere neutral to close the open popover: true = auto (dialog title / blank area), or a target.

move_ms.description: Cursor travel duration (ms). Default: computed from distance.

offset.description: Offset from the element's top-left in CSS px (default: centre).

params.description: Component params (see the component's params schema; unset params take its defaults).

SceneTransition.description: crossfade, cut or fade-black (the theme's transition of that kind), or a transition component: its id (e.g. studio/transition-tap-open) or {component, params}.

text.description: Card text, e.g. "A few hours later" (not needed for a video, image or lottie file).

style.description: Legacy template interstitial style override (dark-clock, paper, dark); ignored when `component` is set.

component.description: Interstitial component "namespace/name" (default: the theme's), e.g. studio/interstitial-clock.

params.description: Component params (see the component's params schema; unset params take its defaults).

video.description: A video file of the project (.mp4, .mov, .webm, .m4v — H.264, HEVC, VP8, VP9, AV1 or ProRes) shown instead of a component; its own sound is kept.

image.description: An image file of the project (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .svg) shown instead of a component.

lottie.description: A Lottie animation of the project (bodymovin .json) played by studio/lottie instead of a component.

from.description: Video: the second of the file the part shown starts at (default 0).

to.description: Video: the second of the file the part shown ends at (default: the file's end).

fit.description: cover (fills, cropped) or contain (whole). Default: an overlay contains; a segment covers when the file has about the frame's shape, else contains.

background.description: Around a contained or transparent file: theme (the theme background, default), a theme colour key (paper, dark, accent…), a CSS colour or none.

volume.description: Video: volume of the file's own sound, 0–1 (default 1).

interstitial.description: "Time passes" card: text, kicker, duration, component, params — or a video, image or lottie file.

id.description: Interstitial id (default "interstitial-<index>").

transition.description: Transition INTO this card: crossfade, cut, fade-black or a transition component, e.g. studio/transition-tap-open (default: the theme's).

video.description: A video file of the project (.mp4, .mov, .webm, .m4v — H.264, HEVC, VP8, VP9, AV1 or ProRes) shown instead of a component; its own sound is kept.

image.description: An image file of the project (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .svg) shown instead of a component.

lottie.description: A Lottie animation of the project (bodymovin .json) played by studio/lottie instead of a component.

from.description: Video: the second of the file the part shown starts at (default 0).

to.description: Video: the second of the file the part shown ends at (default: the file's end).

volume.description: Video: volume of the file's own sound, 0–1 (default 1).

card.description: Full-screen card: component, params, slots, duration, transition — or a video, image or lottie file.
